name: 61822 · Champaign, IL
findings: ZIP 61822 (Champaign) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61822 (Champaign) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
